policy_requirement: Current NASDAQ account value/exposure must be known for TRUE FULL GO; unresolved account state caps final status but must not suppress a valid research candidate.
pass_rule: A sanctioned connected broker adapter must, in the same run, return parseable current account value/cash state and current equity positions/exposure. Empty positions are valid known exposure. Permission/auth/tool errors are never PASS.
persistence_rule: Never persist balances, positions, account identifiers, buying power, or other private account values to the public repository; persist status/provenance only.

LONGBRIDGE.diagnostic: market-data + watchlist work after full reauth, while account_balance, stock_positions, fund_positions and today_orders remain scope-denied

ALPACA_CHATGPT_CONNECTOR.diagnostic: Current connected Alpaca tool surface exposes market/reference data but no account-balance/positions tools.

TRADING212_PUBLIC_API.diagnostic: Official Public API has account summary/positions, but current supported-country list does not include Turkey.

A surfaced ChatGPT/finance connector was not eligible for installation in the current workspace.
IBKR_WEB_API.blocker: No currently connected scheduler-callable IBKR account adapter; live individual API is funded-account + IBKR Pro dependent.
IBKR_WEB_API.reopen_condition: A sanctioned IBKR connector becomes connectable in this workspace OR a compliant scheduler-callable first-party API path is established, then same-run read-only account summary + positions succeed.

MIDAS_ATLAS_COMMUNITY_CONNECTOR.diagnostic: Community connector can read portfolio-shaped data, but it is not an official Midas connector and is not connected to this scheduler.
MIDAS_ATLAS_COMMUNITY_CONNECTOR.reopen_condition: Official or explicitly authorized read-only Midas connector becomes available and fresh same-run account-state reads succeed.

ETRADE_DEVELOPER_API.sanctioned_surface: Official E*TRADE Developer API with OAuth and live individual API key
diagnostics: Official API exposes balances and current positions.
No E*TRADE account/connector is currently connected in this ChatGPT session.
This adapter may never PASS from documentation alone; it requires same-run authenticated readback from the user's own account.
ETRADE_DEVELOPER_API.g9_note: Separate from ACCOUNT eligibility. E*TRADE market-data terms do not satisfy current strict G9 permanent-$0 proof.

evidence: Midas officially supports authenticated brokerage connection through TradingView Trading Panel.
TradingView broker integration exposes account metadata, balance/equity state and positions; these are the exact read categories needed by the provider-neutral ACCOUNT gate.
TradingView documents sub-2-second polling/update paths for balances, account manager and positions.
No sanctioned end-user TradingView/Midas connector or callable API is currently exposed to the canonical ChatGPT scheduler.
MIDAS_VIA_TRADINGVIEW_OFFICIAL.blocker: Technical read surface is proven, but canonical scheduler callability, safe user-token handoff and a non-disruptive session model are not available.
MIDAS_VIA_TRADINGVIEW_OFFICIAL.reopen_condition: A sanctioned Midas or TradingView end-user connector/API becomes scheduler-callable with a session-safe authorization model, then fresh same-run read-only account value/cash and equity positions/exposure both parse successfully.
MIDAS_VIA_TRADINGVIEW_OFFICIAL.session_constraint: Midas support states the same customer account cannot be simultaneously connected to TradingView and the Midas application. A future canonical adapter must use an explicitly supported independent/service-token model or equivalent session-safe mechanism; it must not hijack or terminate the user's interactive Midas session.

evidence: Midas officially uses Alpaca Broker API for US brokerage infrastructure.
Alpaca broker partners can provide OAuth services to their correspondent end users.
Correspondent accounts do not receive personal Alpaca Trading API key/secret credentials.
A Midas-controlled OAuth or read-only connector would therefore be required for canonical access.
MIDAS_ALPACA_CORRESPONDENT.blocker: No Midas-controlled scheduler-callable read-only OAuth/API is currently exposed to this runtime.
MIDAS_ALPACA_CORRESPONDENT.reopen_condition: Midas publishes or explicitly authorizes a read-only OAuth/API/connector for its Alpaca-backed account and same-run account value/cash plus equity positions/exposure parse successfully.

LONGBRIDGE_DIRECT_OPENAPI.security_model: Credentials must be supplied only through secure runtime secrets. Probe output persists status/provenance/run metadata only; no balances, positions, account identifiers, or credentials.
LONGBRIDGE_DIRECT_OPENAPI.canonical_gate_rule: Only the production final-gate workflow may activate this adapter, using secure runtime secrets and fresh same-run read-only account_balance + stock_positions. No persisted provider result can create PASS.
LONGBRIDGE_DIRECT_OPENAPI.blocker: GitHub Actions secrets for the three official Legacy API Key credentials are not yet configured.
evidence: Official Longbridge Getting Started documentation defines Legacy API Key as App Key + App Secret + Legacy Access Token from User Center, distinct from OAuth tokens.
Official Longbridge examples use Config.from_apikey_env() with TradeContext.account_balance().
Official Stock Positions documentation exposes TradeContext.stock_positions / GET /v1/asset/stock.
Probe source imports Longbridge only after all three secrets are present; without them it is network-free fail-closed.
Probe source contains no order/replace/cancel/submit/withdraw calls and persists no private account values or secrets.
Positive same-run and stale-run behavior is covered by network-free regression tests.
LONGBRIDGE_DIRECT_OPENAPI.reopen_condition: Configure the three Legacy API Key credentials as GitHub Actions secrets; then the final factory itself must obtain fresh same-run parseable account_balance + stock_positions.
LONGBRIDGE_DIRECT_OPENAPI.same_run_rule: ACCOUNT_PASS may be created only when the production final-gate run itself invokes the read-only probe and both account_balance and stock_positions parse successfully in that exact workflow run.
LONGBRIDGE_DIRECT_OPENAPI.persisted_pass_rule: A prior probe result or persisted PASS may never be reused to create current ACCOUNT_PASS.

transition_to_pass: Only fresh same-run provider readback satisfying the pass_rule may set ACCOUNT=PASS. Persisted prior PASS alone is insufficient.
